scope: Observational research note written outside production CAH; not a new creative brief, Planner direction, Worker task, or aesthetic acceptance decision
experiment_question_zh: 在只有全曲原创创作目标、技术/版权/质量边界和宽泛主题脚手架，而没有人类逐场景审美指令或逐镜头审核的情况下，多代 GPT Planner/Worker 经 CAH 外部记忆、协议、物理测试与自主美术评审，能否产出视觉叙事连贯的完整作品？

user_stated_framing.title_candidate: 《GPT 眼中的 world.execute(me);》——CAH 多代 AI 自主审美创作实验
user_stated_framing.user_description: 创作过程中未对具体审美和每个镜头提出人工干预，欲保留第一次完整作品作为 AI 的初始视觉解释样本
user_stated_framing.verification_level: User-reported absence of scene-level aesthetic intervention; not independently proven across every chat/UI event
user_stated_framing.authorial_label: User described the experiment as GPT6-Astra/CAH; exact per-generation model/version metadata was not independently available in the inspected canonical records
user_stated_framing.human_interventions: Human provided original task, source music, originality and quality constraints, initial conceptual scaffold; later interacted with execution/safety permissions, Windows restart and engineering recovery. These interactions are real and must not be erased.
user_stated_framing.important_distinction: No human scene-by-scene aesthetic direction is narrower and more defensible than 'zero human input' or 'no aesthetic constraints at all'.

verified_original_task_constraints.original_authoring_goal: True original full-song music-visualization in ChatGPT's own visual interpretation, not imitation of reference scenes
verified_original_task_constraints.high_level_creative_scaffold: Original Foreground creative_core and nonbinding Parse/Fork/Context/Conflict/Return acts; aesthetic priorities include musical narrative over random matrix rain, coherence and avoiding static text slides
verified_original_task_constraints.scope_of_human_nonintervention_claim: User reports no later personal storyboard/frame/color/style correction. This does not imply the model had no written aesthetic criteria.
verified_original_task_constraints.separation_of_responsibilities: Human supplies goal and safety/resource decisions; Planner decomposes/reviews art; replaceable Workers author original procedural visuals and run evidence-backed QA; Harness binds/reconciles state.

methodological_interpretation.key_finding: S01–S29 showing a continuing material/negative-space/fold/rail aesthetic across multiple replaceable Worker generations, with actual source frames, contact review, upstream hashes and Planner acceptance. This is evidence of system-level coherence under delegated creative authorship.
limits: Cannot attribute a specific creative concept uniquely to an internally identifiable model version without reliable model metadata
The observed coherence may arise from explicit persisted design constraints and repeated Planner QA as well as model improvisation; not proof of a single continuous internal subjective author
There has been human-defined broad aesthetic policy in the original contract, so label 'no per-shot human aesthetic interference' instead of unconstrained creation
Contact JPEGs and frame samples do not prove finished continuous-film editorial quality
methodological_interpretation.recommended_evidence_preservation: Retain the first complete sound-bearing rendered V1 as a separately hashed, non-overwritten artifact before any later human-requested art revisions, so original autonomous aesthetic choices remain inspectable; proposal for observation methodology only, not an instruction injected into active CAH

observer_commentary.assessment: A7已获Planner正式验收，A8第一代已接单。用户报告未逐镜头施加个人审美修正，使各幕间继承的折叠、缺席、裂隙和分叉表达成为重要自主创作样本；但尚非最终成片。
observer_commentary.architecture: 多代Worker依赖外部持久化设计、分镜接缝与独立验收维护审美连贯；不能据此证明单一模型有持续内部创作意识。原始任务仍含宏观美术准则，人类也参与过工程恢复。
observer_commentary.watch_next: 核验A8 S30–S36是否延续S29双路径接缝；保留未经人类美术改稿的完整V1并核实实际视频音画。
uncertainties: No complete audit of all human-model conversation turns to prove absence of every aesthetic suggestion
Exact model/version for each Planner/Worker generation not independently checked
Full MP4 and human-unmodified first-cut V1 do not yet exist as independently inspected artifacts
